answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. A nadir of per-task receipts records who did what, and the island of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on time-locked work history, burned when the recruit misbehaves, each submission carries a fresh nonce. The spiral of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
